text:
### Risk Scoring  
| Risk Factor | Score | Action |
|---|---|---|
| **Low Risk** | <25 | Proceed with standard process |
| **Medium Risk** | 25–50 | Standard screening + confirm with customer |
| **High Risk** | 50–75 | Compliance review required |
| **Very High Risk** | 75+ | Escalate to Compliance Head, may block change |  
**Example Risk Calculation:**
```
Base Risk: 0
+ UK domestic move: 0
+ Permanent change: 0
+ No sanctions history: 0
= Low Risk (0)
→ Proceed with standard process

---

Base Risk: 0
+ Move to high-risk country (Iran): +50
+ No compliance history: 0
+ First move abroad: +20
= High Risk (70)
→ Escalate to Compliance Head
→ May require Enhanced Due Diligence
```

name: Chunk 18/52

raw_entities.name: Risk Score Gate
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that evaluates customer risk based on a scoring matrix and determines the appropriate compliance action. Risk scores are calculated from factors such as geographic location, permanence of change, and compliance history, with four distinct outcome paths: Low Risk (proceed standard), Medium Risk (standard + confirmation), High Risk (compliance review), and Very High Risk (escalation to Compliance Head with possible blocking).
context: Low Risk | <25 | Proceed with standard process
Very High Risk | 75+ | Escalate to Compliance Head, may block change

raw_entities.name: Level 1 — Standard Process
raw_entities.description: The baseline escalation tier for Low Risk customers with scores below 25. Customers at this level proceed with standard process without additional compliance intervention.
context: Low Risk | <25 | Proceed with standard process

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Standard Screening with Customer Confirmation
raw_entities.description: The escalation tier for Medium Risk customers with scores between 25–50. Customers at this level undergo standard screening procedures with mandatory customer confirmation step.
context: Medium Risk | 25–50 | Standard screening + confirm with customer

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Compliance Review
raw_entities.description: The escalation tier for High Risk customers with scores between 50–75. Customers at this level require formal compliance review before proceeding. The example demonstrates a score of 70 triggered by move to high-risk country (Iran) plus first move abroad factors.

raw_entities.name: Level 4 — Compliance Head Escalation
raw_entities.description: The highest escalation tier for Very High Risk customers with scores of 75 or above. Customers at this level are escalated to the Compliance Head with authority to block the change or require Enhanced Due Diligence. This tier has the power to deny or conditionally approve transactions.
context: Very High Risk | 75+ | Escalate to Compliance Head, may block change

raw_entities.name: Risk-Based Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance control point that verifies risk classification before a customer change (such as address change) can proceed. The gate uses a quantitative scoring model incorporating geographic risk, permanence, and compliance history to determine the appropriate level of compliance intervention required.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The senior compliance authority responsible for reviewing and approving or blocking Very High Risk customer changes (risk score 75+). This role has the discretion to escalate to Enhanced Due Diligence or deny the change entirely.
context: Escalate to Compliance Head, may block change

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Representative
raw_entities.description: The frontline operational role responsible for processing Low Risk customer changes using standard procedures without escalation.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Review Officer
raw_entities.description: The compliance specialist responsible for conducting formal compliance review of High Risk customer changes (risk score 50–75) before approval or denial.
